both.","whyItFits":"Combines the teacher's two favorite things—coffee and reading—into a useful everyday item, and takes well under an hour with tools you already extra vinyl, keeping only the design and letters","Use transfer tape to lift the design and place it on the clean, dry mug","Burnish well, then slowly peel back the transfer tape","Wash the mug top rack gently or hand wash to protect the vinyl"],"designTips":"Search your software for 'coffee cup silhouette' and 'open book icon', then weld them together with a short text phrase using the Attach or Weld tool so they cut as one clean layout.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Adhesive vinyl is not food-safe—keep the design on the outside of the mug, away from the rim and inside","Hand washing is recommended to make the design last longer"]}, {"title":"Book Lover’s Canvas Tote Bag","summary":"A natural canvas tote personalized with an iron-on book stack design, great for carrying novels or classroom supplies.","whyItFits":"A tote bag is a practical, decor-friendly gift a teacher can use daily, and iron-on application fits your skill level and time window perfectly.","difficulty":2,"estMinutes":30,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-18","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-06","amount":0.5,"unit":"sheet"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":["household-iron"],"steps":["Design a simple stack-of-books icon, mirrored for iron-on application","Cut the design from the white iron-on sheet using the shiny liner side down","Weed out the extra material, leaving just the design on its clear carrier sheet","Preheat the iron on cotton setting with no steam","Center the design on the tote and press firmly for 20-30 seconds per section","Let cool slightly, then peel the carrier sheet away"],"designTips":"Try searching 'stacked books clipart' and use the Slice tool to add simple page-line details to the books for extra texture.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["Iron gets very hot—keep it moving and never leave it unattended on the fabric","Let the tote cool before handling the design area","Wash inside-out on gentle cycle and skip the dryer to protect the design"]}, {"title":"‘Sip & Read’ Glass Can Tumbler","summary":"A clear glass can tumbler decorated with a cozy coffee-and-book themed vinyl decal, ready for iced coffee or tea.","whyItFits":"Glass can tumblers are trendy home-decor-style drinkware, and this quick vinyl application matches the teacher's coffee-loving personality.","difficulty":1,"estMinutes":25,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-16","amount":1,"unit":"blank"},{"supplyId":"sup-04","amount":0.25,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-26","amount":1,"unit":"piece"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":10,"unit":"in"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design centers","Apply transfer tape over the design and lift it off the backing","Position it around the clean, dry glass can and smooth from the center outward","Peel back the transfer tape slowly to reveal the finished design"],"designTips":"Search 'coffee steam swirl' and 'simple leaf icon' for accents, and use the Curve or Arc tool if your software has one to make text follow the can's round shape.","sellInfo":null,"safetyNotes":["This vinyl is not food or dishwasher safe—hand wash only and keep away from the rim","Glass can crack if dropped—remind the recipient to handle gently"]}, {"title":"Coffee Ring Cork Coaster Set","summary":"A set of four cork coasters with a playful coffee-ring vinyl design, a fun and useful desk accessory.","whyItFits":"Coasters are a classic teacher limits.","difficulty":1,"estMinutes":30,"uses":[{"supplyId":"sup-20","amount":4,"unit":"piece"},{"supplyId":"sup-01","amount":0.5,"unit":"sheet"},{"supplyId":"sup-26","amount":1,"unit":"piece"},{"supplyId":"sup-25","amount":8,"unit":"in"}],"missing":[],"toolsNeeded":["fine-point-cutting-tool"],"equipmentNeeded":[],"steps":["Design coasters"],"designTips":"Search 'coffee ring stain silhouette' or draw a simple circle with a rough uneven edge, then use the Offset tool to create a fun hand-drawn
